CustomField.description: Staging mirror of GiftTransaction.FQS_Gift_Transaction_Category__c. Both fields source their picklist values from the FQS_Gift_Transaction_Category GlobalValueSet so the launcher staging value always matches what lands on the transaction. Written to GiftTransaction.FQS_Gift_Transaction_Category__c on commit.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Category that classifies this transaction: Outright Gift, Pledge Payment, Recurring Gift Payment, Grant Payment, or Other.
CustomField.label: Gift Transaction Category
